name: Radio
description: Native radio buttons grouped for mutually exclusive choices, with an accessible fieldset/legend wrapper
designIntent: Radio lets users pick exactly one option from a visible set. RadioGroup provides the shared name and accessible legend so screen readers announce group context.

props.name: value
props.description: The value this item contributes to the group

props.name: label
props.description: Visible label rendered next to the radio

props.name: onCheckedChange
props.description: Fired when the user selects this radio (on Radio)

props.name: legend
props.description: Accessible group label; rendered as <legend> inside a fieldset (RadioGroup component)

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the newly selected value (RadioGroup component)

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial selected value when uncontrolled (RadioGroup component)

examples.title: Radio group
examples.code:
<RadioGroup name="plan" legend="Choose a plan" defaultValue="free">
  <RadioGroupItem value="free" label="Free" />
  <RadioGroupItem value="pro" label="Pro" />
</RadioGroup>

examples.title: Controlled group
examples.code:
<RadioGroup
  name="plan"
  legend="Plan"
  value={plan}
  onValueChange={setPlan}
>
  <RadioGroupItem value="free" label="Free" />
  <RadioGroupItem value="pro" label="Pro" />
</RadioGroup>

antiPatterns.title: Don't use Radio for multi-select
antiPatterns.explanation: Radio is single-choice. Use Checkbox when users can pick more than one option.

antiPatterns.title: Don't render bare radios without a group
antiPatterns.explanation: Without RadioGroup there is no shared name or legend, so screen readers can't convey the grouping.

accessibility.implementation: RadioGroup renders a fieldset with a legend so the group name is announced
accessibility.userRequirements: Always provide a legend describing the choice

accessibility.implementation: Native radio behavior: arrows move selection within the group

guidelines: Make options mutually exclusive and collectively exhaustive
Include an Other/free-text option when the set can't be closed

compositionRules.relationship: Always wrap Radio/RadioGroupItem in a RadioGroup
